Acorn ILQBP Iron Art Door Pull And Plates

text.description_html:
Acorn ILQBP, Hand Forged Iron Door Arched Pull Plate

Individual crafted works of art in a style reflective of old world designs, Acorn's Iron Art Pull Plate is reminiscent of styles that can be found on century-old wooden doors. Acorn's ILQBP is forged in Europe in the old world style of hammer and anvil so each piece will vary slightly. Packaged complete with all mounting hardware for easy installation. It features a decorative arched top and bottom backing plate with a solid iron pull. It measures 15-3/4" high and 3-1/2" wide with a 10" hand forged decorative handle.

Also available: matching Door Push Plate

Specifications of the Acorn ILQBP Iron Art Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Plate Height 15-3/4"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Pull Height: 10"
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Pull Projection: 4"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Finish Warranty

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application. This door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
